title: Filterable roster with row actions and an empty state
prompt: Build a crew roster. Heading: "Crew". A search field labelled "Filter crew" narrows the list by name as the user types. The list shows five people, each with a name and a role: Ada Okafor (Flight engineer), Bo Lindqvist (Navigator), Chen Wei (Pilot), Dara Moss (Medic), Eli Hart (Comms). Each row has a compact actions button labelled "Actions for <name>" (for example "Actions for Ada Okafor") that opens a short list of actions: "Edit", "Reassign" and "Remove". Choosing Remove takes that person off the list. When nobody matches the filter, show "No crew match your filter." and a button "Clear filter" that empties the field and shows everyone again.
